lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: In 2018, Elon Musk sold twenty thousand flamethrowers.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Five hundred dollars each. Gone in four days.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: So Joe Rogan asked him: isn't that a terrible idea?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Okay. But is it even a real flamethrower?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Twenty thousand sold. By telling everyone not to buy one.
